Who We Help

We buy houses in any situation

Life doesn't always go to plan. Whatever brought you here, we've seen it before and we're ready to help — without judgment.

01
Foreclosure or Behind on Payments
A fast cash sale can stop the foreclosure process and let you walk away with cash — before the bank takes everything.
02
Inherited Property / Probate
We work with estates in probate and inherited homes throughout Missouri. We handle the complexity so you don't have to.
03
Divorce or Separation
A quick, clean sale removes the house from the equation so both parties can move forward without the property becoming a prolonged battle.
04
Relocating Fast
Job transfer, family situation, or just ready for a fresh start — we close on your timeline so the house doesn't hold you back.
05
House Needs Major Repairs
Foundation issues, roof damage, fire damage, code violations — we buy as-is. You don't spend a dollar fixing anything before we close.
06
Tired Landlord
Problem tenants, nonpayment, or just done with the headache — we can buy your rental property even with tenants in place.
07
Behind on Taxes or Liens
Tax liens, HOA debt, or other encumbrances don't have to block the sale. We've navigated complex title situations throughout Missouri before.
08
Vacant or Abandoned Property
Sitting on a property that's costing you money every month? We'll take it off your hands quickly and put cash in your pocket.
09
Any Other Situation
If your situation isn't listed here, call us anyway. In 7 years of buying houses in Missouri we've helped in situations others said were impossible.

Who You're Working With

with Nahom

We have virtual assistants ready to help you connect with Nahom quickly. When you reach out, you're getting to the person who makes the offer and signs at closing.

Nahom
Founder & Buyer

I started buying houses in Missouri because I kept meeting people stuck with a property that had become a burden — an inherited home two states away, a rental that stopped making sense, a house that needed more work than the owner could afford.

The traditional route doesn't serve those people well. Listing means repairs, showings, commissions, and months of waiting on a buyer's financing to come through. Sometimes that's the right call. Often it isn't.

My job is to give you a clear number and let you decide. I'll walk you through exactly how I got to it. If selling to me isn't your best option, I'll tell you that too — I'd rather be straight with you than talk you into something.

Have a property or a question? Call or text me directly at (314) 322-2100.
Meet the Buyer

You'll work with Nahom, not a call center

We have virtual assistants ready to help you connect — but when you submit your property, Nahom is the one who reviews it and makes the offer.

I started buying houses in Missouri because I kept meeting people stuck with a property and no good options — an inherited home two states away, a rental that turned into a headache, a house that needed more work than it was worth.

The traditional process wasn't built for those situations. Listing takes months, agents want repairs done first, and buyers fall out of contract at the last minute. Sometimes you just need a straight answer and a firm number.

That's what I do. I look at your property, tell you what I can pay and how I got there, and you decide. No pressure, no bait-and-switch, and no offer that quietly drops before closing.

Common Questions

Answers to what
sellers ask us most

Yes — we buy houses as-is throughout Missouri. Foundation issues, roof damage, fire damage, water damage, code violations, hoarder homes — we've bought them all. You don't spend a dollar fixing anything before we close.

We look at the property's location, condition, and what comparable homes have sold for in the area. We factor in the cost of repairs and updates needed, and we make a fair offer based on that math. We'll walk you through the numbers — no mystery.

None at all. Getting a cash offer from us is 100% free with no strings attached. You can take the offer, turn it down, or use it to inform other decisions. We never pressure anyone.

Yes. We work with estates in probate regularly and have experience navigating title issues, liens, and other complications. These situations take more time but we've handled them throughout Missouri for 7 years.

We can still buy it. We work with landlords who need to sell rental properties even with tenants in place. We'll discuss the situation and find a path that works.

When you list with an agent, you're waiting for a buyer — typically 3-6 months — and paying 3-6% in commissions plus closing costs and often repair expenses. When you sell to us, you skip all of that. You get cash, you close fast, and you pay nothing. The tradeoff is that our offer will be below full market value — we need room to cover repairs and profit. But many sellers find the certainty and speed is worth more than waiting for top dollar.

As fast as 7 days in most cases. The timeline depends on title search and any complications with the property. We'll give you a realistic closing date upfront — we don't make promises we can't keep.
